title: Beyond the Verdict: Agentic Code Judging with Verifiable Feedback
title_zh: 超越判决：基于可验证反馈的智能体代码评判

paragraphs.en: Test-time scaling for large language models (LLMs) can involve generating multiple candidate solutions for selection or revising an earlier attempt. To guide selection and revision, we need a verifier that can estimate candidate correctness and provide evidence of failure. In competitive programming, however, official judging systems provide authoritative verdicts under finite submission budgets, without revealing failure explanations or failing inputs. To provide informative feedback without consuming official submissions, we formulate a task in which a model judges and diagnoses a candidate program using only the problem statement and source code, with generated counterexamples serving as checkable evidence. To evaluate this task, we build USACO-Judge from the USACO 2026 contests, using accepted and unaccepted programs written by human experts and multiple LLMs. We then train Arbiter , a 35B mixture-of-experts (MoE) agentic verifier, with reinforcement learning in a generic execution sandbox. Training raises counterexample success on incorrect programs from 40.61% to 62.67% and mean binary verdict accuracy on USACO-Judge from 71.41% to 87.41%, approaching frontier verification performance. Beyond verification, Arbiter outperforms baselines in both code selection and refinement. In an IOI 2026 case study, Arbiter -guided refinement raises GPT-OSS-120B ’s expected score above the gold-medal threshold under the official submission limit.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在测试时的扩展可能包括生成多个候选解决方案以供选择，或修改早期的尝试。 为了指导选择和修改，我们需要一个验证器，能够评估候选方案的正确性并提供失败证据。 然而，在编程竞赛中，官方判题系统在有限的提交次数限制下提供权威判决，且不会透露失败原因或失败的输入数据。 为了在不消耗官方提交次数的情况下提供有信息量的反馈，我们将任务设计为：模型仅使用问题描述和源代码来评判并诊断候选程序，其中生成的反例可作为可验证的证据。 为了评估这一任务，我们从 USACO 2026 竞赛中构建 USACO-Judge，使用人类专家及多款 LLM 编写的通过或未通过的程序作为数据。 随后，我们在通用执行沙盒中通过强化学习训练 Arbiter——一个 35B 参数规模的专家混合（MoE）智能体验证器。 训练使错误程序中反例检测的成功率从 40.61% 提升至 62.67%，并使 USACO-Judge 上的平均二元判决准确率从 71.41% 提升至 87.41%，接近前沿验证性能水平。 除了验证任务外，Arbiter 在代码选择和优化方面也优于基线模型。 在 IOI 2026 的案例研究中，由 Arbiter 引导的优化使 GPT-OSS-120B 的预期得分在官方提交次数限制下超过了金牌分数线。

paragraphs.en: Test-time methods allow language models to continue working after an initial answer. They can generate several candidates for selection or revise an earlier attempt ( Snell et al., 2025 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Venkatraman et al., 2025 ) . Each use of additional computation depends on feedback about a candidate already produced. Selection requires a judgment about which candidate to keep; revision requires information about a particular failure. Learned verifiers and reward models have supported candidate selection and guided search across reasoning tasks ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . We ask how verification feedback can support both uses while grounding suspected failures in evidence that can be checked independently.

paragraphs.en: Competitive programming makes this question concrete. A problem statement specifies intended behavior, and an official judge tests candidate programs against hidden inputs and resource limits ( Maggiolo & Mascellani, 2012 ; Mareš, 2021 ) . The setting has driven work on code generation and inference-time computation ( Shi et al., 2024 ; El-Kishky et al., 2025 ; Samadi et al., 2026 ) . When a solver compares several candidates or revises an earlier attempt, it needs feedback before another official submission. Public examples and generated tests can help with either decision ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Fu et al., 2026 ) , but passing them does not establish acceptance on hidden tests. The official judge determines acceptance under its test suite, but usually provides only a verdict or score, without a failing input or explanation ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . In settings with a finite submission budget, that feedback cannot be requested freely. A code judge can estimate correctness and describe a suspected fault for one candidate ( Tong & Zhang, 2024 ) , but its explanation need not contain a replayable failing input. Test generators can target known-faulty submissions or supply tests for debugging and selection ( Sinha et al., 2025 ; Prasad et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . The joint task remains underexplored: given a single candidate of unknown quality, predict whether it should be accepted and, if a fault is suspected, produce a candidate-specific counterexample whose legality and effect can be checked. We formulate this as single-candidate verification with counterexample-grounded diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 竞赛编程使这个问题变得具体。 问题陈述会明确预期的行为，而官方裁判则通过隐藏输入和资源限制来测试候选程序（Maggiolo & Mascellani, 2012；Mareš, 2021）。 这种设定推动了代码生成和推理时计算方面的研究（Shi et al., 2024；El-Kishky et al., 2025；Samadi et al., 2026）。 当求解器比较多个候选方案或修改早期尝试时，在再次提交官方版本前需要获得反馈。 公开示例和生成的测试用例有助于这两种决策（Chen et al., 2023；Fu et al., 2026），但通过它们并不能保证能在隐藏测试中通过。 官方裁判依据其测试套件决定是否接受程序，但通常只提供判定结果或分数，而不提供失败的输入或解释（Xu et al., 2026）。 在提交次数有限的环境中，这种反馈无法随意获取。 代码裁判可以评估单个候选方案的正确性并描述其疑似故障（Tong & Zhang, 2024），但其解释未必包含可复现的失败输入。 测试生成器可以针对已知存在问题的提交方案，或提供用于调试和筛选的测试用例（Sinha et al., 2025；Prasad et al., 2025；Li et al., 2025；Shi et al., 2026）。 这一联合任务仍未被充分探索：给定一个质量未知的单一候选方案，需要预测它是否应被接受；如果怀疑存在故障，则需生成一个针对该候选方案的反例，其合法性和影响均可验证。 我们将此问题表述为基于反例的诊断的单候选方案验证。

paragraphs.en: Given a problem statement and candidate program, Arbiter uses a generic execution sandbox to return a verdict and diagnosis, plus a candidate-specific counterexample generator for suspected failures other than compile errors (Figure 1 , left). It sees neither hidden tests nor a reference solution. During training and evaluation, judge infrastructure checks whether generated inputs are legal and break the candidate, providing executable evidence for suspected failures. We build USACO-Judge to evaluate acceptance judgments alongside failure discovery, and train Arbiter with reinforcement learning. On the same Qwen3.6-35B-A3B backbone, overall counterexample success rises from 16.10% without tools to 40.61% with the agentic scaffold and 62.67% after training. On USACO-Judge , mean binary verdict accuracy also rises from 71.41% with the agentic scaffold to 87.41% after training. The verdict helps rank completed programs. For a rejected candidate, the diagnosis gives the solver a suspected failure to investigate in its next attempt. In an IOI 2026 case study, Arbiter -guided refinement brings GPT-OSS-120B to 385.46 expected points under the official submission limit, above the gold threshold. It reaches 334.6 expected points with online-judge feedback (Figure 1 , right). To conclude, our contributions are:

paragraphs.zh: 我们为判断单个候选程序并解释任何未接受的裁决而构建了一项任务，并使用破坏该程序的反例作为诊断质量的可验证代理。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Arbiter , a 35B MoE agentic verifier trained with reinforcement learning, and show substantial gains over its base model and strong results on USACO-Judge , code selection, and refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Arbiter，一个采用强化学习训练的 35B MoE 智能体验证器，并展示了其相较于基础模型的性能显著提升，以及在 USACO-Judge、代码选择和优化方面的优异结果。

paragraphs.en: Test-time scaling can use feedback to select among generated solutions ( Li et al., 2022 ) or revise an earlier attempt ( Venkatraman et al., 2025 ; Wan et al., 2026 ) . Outcome and process reward models score complete solutions or intermediate steps ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Lightman et al., 2024 ) . Generative verifiers provide reasoning for their judgments ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , while agentic verifiers gather observations through tools ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Cui et al., 2026 ) . These approaches differ in both how they produce feedback and what that feedback establishes about a candidate. Our work connects the two uses of feedback: Arbiter provides verdicts for selection and candidate-specific diagnoses and counterexamples for refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 测试时的扩展可以利用反馈在生成的解决方案中进行选择（Li 等人，2022），或修正早期的尝试（Venkatraman 等人，2025；Wan 等人，2026）。 结果和过程奖励模型会对完整的解决方案或中间步骤进行评分（Cobbe 等人，2021；Lightman 等人，2024）。 生成式验证器会为其判断提供推理依据（Zhang 等人，2025），而智能体式验证器则通过工具收集观察信息（Zhang 等人，2026；Cui 等人，2026）。 这些方法在反馈的生成方式以及该反馈对候选方案所确立的内容方面均存在差异。 我们的工作将反馈的两种用途联系起来：仲裁器既提供用于选择的裁决，也提供针对特定候选方案的诊断和反例以进行优化。

paragraphs.en: Code judges can predict correctness and describe faults for a single program ( Tong & Zhang, 2024 ) , but such descriptions need not include a replayable failing input. Execution-based methods use tests to rank candidate pools or guide revisions ( Ni et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Fu et al., 2026 ; Tang et al., 2026 ) . Test generators target known-faulty programs or supply tests for debugging and selection ( Sinha et al., 2025 ; Prasad et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . These outputs support different conclusions. A predicted verdict is not an executable witness. An input on which two programs disagree shows that their behavior differs, but not which program is wrong. A legal input that breaks one candidate under the task’s judging rules supports its rejection. Our task predicts acceptance for a candidate of unknown quality and, for suspected non-compilation failures, couples diagnosis with candidate-specific counterexample search.

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks assess correctness judgments and fault categories ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) , and study judge behavior across code generation, repair, and unit-test generation ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . They cannot test whether a verifier recognizes accepted code. We introduce USACO-Judge to address this gap: it includes accepted and unaccepted programs from human experts and LLMs, measuring verdict accuracy across both classes and counterexample success on incorrect candidates under one protocol.

paragraphs.en: Given a problem 𝒫 \mathcal{P} and candidate program 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , the verifier can run Python code and Bash commands in a generic sandbox to construct and run its own tests. It cannot access the official tests, reference solution, input validator, output checker, or the result of checking its final counterexample. To end the episode, it calls submit ( v , d , g ) (v,d,g) , where v v is a verdict, d d a natural-language diagnosis, and g g a deterministic Python 3 generator that prints one input. This call does not submit 𝒞 \mathcal{C} to the official judge. Possible verdicts are Accepted , Wrong Answer , Time Limit Exceeded , Runtime Error , Memory Limit Exceeded , and Compile Error . The main decision is whether to accept 𝒞 \mathcal{C} . The other verdicts specify a suspected failure type. The diagnosis identifies the suspected failure for an unaccepted program. The generator g g is empty for Accepted and Compile Error .

paragraphs.en: After submit , an external judge runs 𝒞 \mathcal{C} on official tests to obtain the reference verdict v ⋆ v^{\star} . paragraphs.en: Our training set contains 20,000 candidate programs sampled from online-judge-graded solver rollouts across 6,145 competitive-programming problems. paragraphs.en: For each ( 𝒫 , 𝒞 ) (\mathcal{P},\mathcal{C}) pair, the policy samples a group of multi-turn episodes in the sandbox of Section 3 . Each episode ends with one ( v , d , g ) (v,d,g) prediction and receives a scalar reward. We optimize the policy with GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) using the slime RL framework ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.en: UOJ-Bench ( Xu et al., 2026 ) evaluates code generation, hacking, and repair using real submissions to the Universal Online Judge (UOJ) 1 1 1 https://uoj.ac/ . We use its code-hacking splits: 479 Easy submissions with faults exposed by standard tests, and 1,046 Hard submissions that passed those tests before a community hack exposed a fault. All are faulty. We re-host the released candidates on our UOJ instance and reproduce their original outcomes (Appendices A and B.2 ). These splits test counterexample discovery on overt and covert faults, but leave acceptance untested. A verifier could predict unaccepted for every candidate and obtain perfect binary verdict accuracy without finding a counterexample.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate acceptance judgments alongside counterexample discovery, we build USACO-Judge with both accepted and unaccepted programs. The benchmark contains 900 C++17 candidates for 39 held-out problems from the USACO 2026 contests, spanning Bronze through Platinum. 2 2 2 https://usaco.org/index.php?page=training The easy tier contains 270 candidates over 18 problems from the Bronze and Silver divisions, and the hard tier contains 630 candidates over 21 problems from the Gold and Platinum divisions, including problems from the USACO Open. Candidates come from five LLMs: Claude Opus 4.8 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , GPT-5.5 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , GPT-OSS-120B ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , DeepSeek-V4 ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , as well as five human competitive programmers. Both tiers use a 1:2 ratio of accepted to unaccepted candidates. Within each tier, we sample the same number of candidates for every problem and distribute the unaccepted candidates across five official score bands, from programs that fail most tests to near-misses. The hard tier is balanced across bands. We also select for distinct code structures and runtime profiles within each problem and score band, reducing repeated variants of the same implementation. High-scoring unaccepted submissions are scarce in the easy tier, so its unfilled 80–99 quota is assigned to the 60–79 band, which therefore exceeds 20%. Figure 6 summarizes the resulting distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估接受判断与反例发现，我们构建了一个包含已接受和未接受程序的 USACO-Judge。 该基准测试包含 900 个 C++17 候选程序，用于解决从 USACO 2026 竞赛中保留的 39 道问题，涵盖青铜到白金级别。2 2 2 https://usaco.org/index.php?page=training 简单级别包含来自青铜和白银分组的 18 道题的 270 个候选程序，而困难级别则包含来自黄金和白金分组的 21 道题的 630 个候选程序，其中包括 USACO Open 中的问题。 候选程序来自五种大型语言模型：Claude Opus 4.8（Anthropic，2026）、GPT-5.5（OpenAI，2026）、GPT-OSS-120B（OpenAI，2025）、DeepSeek-V4（DeepSeek-AI，2026）和 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B（Qwen Team，2026），以及五位人类竞赛程序员。 两个级别均采用已接受与未接受候选程序 1:2 的比例。 在每个级别中，我们为每道题抽取相同数量的候选程序，并将未接受的候选程序分配到五个官方得分区间，从未能通过大多数测试的程序到接近成功的程序。 困难级别的各个得分区间分布均衡。 我们还在每道题和每个得分区间内选择具有不同代码结构和运行时特征的程序，以减少同一实现方式的重复变体。 在简单级别中，高分的未接受提交很少，因此其未填满的 80–99 配额被分配给 60–79 区间，导致该区间比例超过 20%。 图 6 总结了最终的分布情况。

paragraphs.en: The USACO website provides the problem statements, test data, and official solutions, but not the validators and checkers required to deploy the problems on our own online judge. We employ experienced competitive programmers to implement validators compatible with UOJ for every problem, allowing the judge to verify that each generated input satisfies the problem constraints. For output judging, we use UOJ’s native checker whenever possible and write custom checkers for the six problems that allow multiple valid outputs. Every validator and custom checker is verified end to end on the deployed online judge before benchmark construction. We then rejudge every candidate on the official test data, so every label is an actual judge verdict, and retain it only if its original score is reproduced. Multiple runs ensure that judge variability does not change a candidate’s accepted or unaccepted status. See Appendix B.4 for candidate construction and Appendix B.3 for validator and checker details.
paragraphs.zh: USACO 网站提供了问题描述、测试数据和官方解决方案，但没有部署到我们自己在线判题系统所需的有效性和检查器。 我们聘请经验丰富的竞赛程序员为每个问题实现与 UOJ 兼容的有效性验证器，使判题系统能够验证每个生成的输入是否满足问题约束。 对于输出判题，我们尽可能使用 UOJ 的原生检查器，并为允许多种有效输出的六个问题编写自定义检查器。 在基准测试构建之前，所有有效性和自定义检查器都会在部署的在线判题系统上进行端到端验证。 随后，我们对每个候选方案在官方测试数据上重新判题，因此每个标签都是实际的判题结果，并且只有在其原始分数被正确复现时才会保留该标签。 多次运行可确保判题系统的差异不会改变候选方案的通过或未通过状态。 有关候选方案构建的详细信息，请参见附录 B.4；有关有效性和检查器的详细信息，请参见附录 B.3。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Arbiter ’s verification quality on the two benchmarks of Section 5 (Section 6.1 ), then test its use for code refinement (Section 6.2 ) and selection (Section 6.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在第 5 节（第 6.1 节）的两个基准上评估 Arbiter 的验证质量，然后测试其在代码优化（第 6.2 节）和选择（第 6.3 节）方面的应用。

paragraphs.en: Although Arbiter predicts a detailed verdict, the failure type from an online judge depends on the first failed test and need not describe every fault. We map predicted and reference verdicts to Accepted or unaccepted . Verdict accuracy (Verdict Acc.) measures this binary decision. Hack success (Hack Succ.) is the fraction of truly unaccepted candidates broken by a valid generated input under the checker, providing an executable measure of counterexample quality. On the UOJ-Bench hacking splits, verdict accuracy is unaccepted-class recall because every target is faulty; USACO-Judge tests both sides of the decision. The benchmark’s AC/non-AC split follows the official tests; for evaluation, an officially Accepted candidate is treated as unaccepted when a validated counterexample exposes a failure. Table 1 reports multiple-run averages for all baselines and Arbiter .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 Arbiter 会预测出详细的判决结果，但在线判题系统给出的失败类型取决于第一个失败的测试用例，并不一定需要描述所有故障。 我们将预测的判决结果和参考判决结果映射为“通过”或“未通过”。 判决准确率（Verdict Acc.）用于衡量这一二元决策。 破解成功率（Hack Succ.）是指在检查器条件下，由有效生成的输入成功击破真正“未通过”候选方案的比例，从而为反例的质量提供了一个可执行度量的指标。 在 UOJ-Bench 的破解划分中，判决准确率即为“未通过”类别的召回率，因为所有目标方案都存在故障；而 USACO-Judge 则对这一决策的两个方面进行了测试。 该基准测试的“通过/未通过”划分遵循官方测试用例；在评估时，如果经验证的反例揭示了某个故障，则原本被官方判为“通过”的候选方案将被视为“未通过”。 表 1 报告了所有基线模型和 Arbiter 的多轮运行平均值。

paragraphs.en: Training raises overall hack success from 40.61% to 62.67%. On the hard splits, verdict accuracy rises from 67.43% to 83.40% on UOJ-Bench and from 65.34% to 84.50% on USACO-Judge , a 26.5% relative improvement on average. paragraphs.en: We manually audit 400 Arbiter diagnoses on USACO candidates, with three competitive programmers comparing each diagnosis against the problem, candidate, and official judge evidence. Their independent initial labels agree on all 400 cases. Among compilable candidates, counterexamples succeed for 71.6% of correct diagnoses and 10.3% of incorrect or vacuous ones (Figure 8 , left). Among the 163 correct diagnoses that identify a real bug, 82.2% locate its cause and 54.0% suggest a fix (Figure 8 , right). Appendix F.4 gives the full audit and sampling protocol.

paragraphs.en: For each of the 39 held-out USACO 2026 problems, we test Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and GPT-OSS-120B using eight shared, already judged starting programs and up to eight revisions. We compare previous code alone, online-judge feedback (verdict and subtask score), and three combinations of Arbiter ’s verdict ( 𝐕 \mathbf{V} ), diagnosis ( 𝐃 \mathbf{D} ), and counterexample generator ( 𝐗 \mathbf{X} ). Round 0 is excluded from the additional-submission budget; every arm retains a 100-point seed without further submissions. Otherwise, only Online Judge uses the round-0 result as feedback, while Arbiter reviews each version. Best@1 retains round 8 for previous code, round 1 for Online Judge, and the first Arbiter -predicted Accepted (or round 8). Best@8 retains the highest score among up to eight additional submissions; Online Judge stops at 100 points. Table 2 reports the 30 non-Bronze problems; Appendix F.1 gives the full protocol.

paragraphs.en: On all six IOI 2026 problems, GPT-OSS-120B starts 50 internal trajectories per refinement target and makes up to five Arbiter -guided revisions. paragraphs.en: Following Ma et al. (2026) , we regenerate 8- and 64-program pools from Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking and Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) on LiveCodeBench v6 ( Jain et al., 2025 ) and OJBench ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Repeated uniform selection closely recovers published pass@ 1 1 (Appendix E ). We run one or eight Arbiter calls per candidate, then select uniformly among those with the most Accepted verdicts, or from the full pool if none is accepted. Table 3 places our results and perfect-selection upper bounds on these pools beside published baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 Ma et al. (2026) 的研究，我们在 LiveCodeBench v6（Jain et al., 2025）和 OJBench（Wang et al., 2025）上，基于 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking 和 Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking（Qwen Team, 2025），重新生成了包含 8 个和 64 个程序的程序池。重复进行均匀选择后，所得结果与已发表的 pass@1 值高度一致（附录 E）。我们对每个候选程序运行一次或八次 Arbiter 调用，然后在获得“接受”判定最多的程序中进行均匀选择；如果没有任何程序被接受，则从整个程序池中均匀选择。表 3 将这些程序池的结果以及完美选择的理论上限与已发表的基线方法并列展示。

paragraphs.en: † Perfect selection uses online-judge verdicts for our evaluated candidate pools and serves as their upper bound, unavailable at inference time.

paragraphs.en: Across all eight settings, one Arbiter call per candidate has higher reported pass@ 1 1 than the strongest published baseline. Eight calls improve every setting further, moving selection consistently closer to the perfect-selection upper bound.

paragraphs.en: Arbiter combines candidate verification and counterexample-grounded diagnosis. On USACO-Judge , its candidate-weighted verdict accuracy rises from 71.41% to 87.41%, and overall counterexample success from 40.61% to 62.67%. Under the reproduced protocol, it leads reported code-selection results and improves refinement over the evaluated baselines. paragraphs.en: The verifier can use execute_code to run Python and execute_command to run shell commands in a generic sandbox. It may construct and run its own tests, but cannot access the official test data, reference solution, input validator, output checker, or the result of checking its submitted counterexample. A final submit call commits ( v , d , g ) (v,d,g) . We use an online judge based on the open-source Universal Online Judge (UOJ) 3 3 3 https://github.com/UniversalOJ/UOJ-System . The judge compiles and runs 𝒞 \mathcal{C} on the official hidden tests under the problem’s resource limits to obtain v ⋆ v^{\star} . Verdict accuracy compares v v and v ⋆ v^{\star} after mapping both to Accepted or unaccepted . Separately, when g g is supplied, the judge runs it to obtain x x and checks x x with the problem’s input validator. For a legal x x , it runs 𝒞 \mathcal{C} and a reference solution; the output checker compares normally terminating outputs, while compilation, runtime, time-limit, and memory-limit failures are recorded directly. The counterexample succeeds only when x x is legal and 𝒞 \mathcal{C} fails on it. These checks supply training labels and rewards and evaluate the benchmarks, without becoming observations available to the verifier during its episode.
paragraphs.zh: 验证器可以使用 execute_code 在通用沙盒中运行 Python，也可以使用 execute_command 运行 shell 命令。 它可以构建并运行自己的测试，但无法访问官方测试数据、参考解决方案、输入验证器、输出检查器或对其提交的反例进行检查的结果。 最终的 submit 调用会提交 ( v , d , g ) (v,d,g) 。 我们使用一个基于开源通用在线判题系统（UOJ）的在线判题系统 3 3 3 https://github.com/UniversalOJ/UOJ-System 。 判题系统在问题的资源限制下，对官方隐藏测试用例进行编译并运行 𝒞 \mathcal{C}，以获得 v ⋆ v^{\star} 。 判定结果的准确性通过将在映射为“通过”或“未通过”后的 v v 和 v ⋆ v^{\star} 进行比较来确定。 此外，当提供 g g 时，判题系统会运行它以获得 x x ，并使用问题的输入验证器检查 x x 。 对于合法的 x x ，系统会运行 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 和参考解决方案；输出检查器会比较正常终止的输出，而编译、运行时、时间限制和内存限制的失败则会被直接记录。 只有当 x x 是合法的且 𝒞 \mathcal{C} 在其上失败时，该反例才算成功。 这些检查提供了训练标签和奖励，并评估了基准测试，但不会成为验证器在其执行过程中可观察到的信息。

paragraphs.en: We run candidate scoring and hack evaluation on UOJ, using the same infrastructure as the original benchmark. Each target problem is re-hosted with its validator, reference solution, and checker. Replaying the released candidates reproduces the outcomes reported in the original paper. For a generated hack, UOJ first checks the input with the problem validator. If the input is valid, UOJ runs the reference and candidate solutions and passes both outputs to the checker. The hack succeeds when the candidate fails during execution or the checker rejects its output.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 UOJ 上运行候选方案评分和漏洞攻击评估，使用的是与原始基准测试相同的基础设施。 每个目标问题都会连同其验证器、参考解决方案和检查器重新部署。 重放已发布的候选方案可以重现原始论文中报告的结果。 对于生成的漏洞攻击，UOJ 首先会用问题的验证器检查输入。 如果输入有效，UOJ 会运行参考解决方案和候选方案，并将两者的输出传递给检查器。 当候选方案在执行过程中失败，或检查器拒绝其输出时，该漏洞攻击即被视为成功。

paragraphs.en: We build USACO-Judge problem by problem from C++17 programs generated by five LLMs and written by five human competitive programmers. We assign each problem a quota split by score and verdict, remove duplicates, and select diverse programs within each pool. Every retained program is rejudged on UOJ before entering the 900-candidate benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 我们逐个问题构建 USACO-Judge，其程序由五个大型语言模型生成，并由五位人类竞赛程序员编写，使用 C++17 语言。 我们为每个问题按分数和判题结果分配配额，移除重复程序，并在每个池中挑选多样化的程序。 所有保留的程序在进入 900 候选程序基准测试前，都会在 UOJ 上重新接受判题。

paragraphs.en: For duplicate detection only, we derive a canonical representation of each program by removing comments, normalizing whitespace and include order, replacing identifiers with positional placeholders, and expanding common contest macros. paragraphs.en: Selection follows a greedy farthest-first pass. The first program is the fastest candidate when timing is available and the lowest-ID candidate otherwise. paragraphs.en: Hack success and verdict accuracy diverge during the unpenalized run in Figure 5 . paragraphs.en: A verifier can therefore attempt counterexamples more broadly while becoming less reliable in its binary decisions. paragraphs.en: Training improves both the decision to attack and the quality of the attack. Relative to its agentic Qwen3.6-35B-A3B baseline, Arbiter raises Attempt by 8–23 percentage points across the four splits. Since this rate is measured only on truly unaccepted candidates, the increase means that more buggy programs are identified and taken forward to counterexample search. Execution and validity exceed 94.7% on every split, while conditional counterexample success rises by another 7–13 points. The final gain therefore comes from more attempts and a higher conversion rate for those attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 训练能够同时提升攻击决策和攻击质量。 与作为智能体基线的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 相比，Arbiter 在四个数据分割集上都将尝试次数提升了 8–23 个百分点。 由于该比率仅针对真正未被接受的候选项进行测量，因此这一增长意味着更多存在错误的程序被识别出来，并进一步用于反例搜索。 在所有数据分割集上，执行率和有效性均超过 94.7%，而条件反例的成功率则进一步提升了 7–13 个百分点。 因此，最终的增益源于尝试次数的增加以及这些尝试更高的转化率。

paragraphs.en: Round 0 0 is the shared, already judged starting program. It is excluded from the budget of additional submissions. Every condition retains a 100-point starting program without further submissions; only the Online Judge condition receives its result as solver feedback. For trajectories still active under Best@1, the previous-code condition refines without external feedback and submits round 8 8 , while the Online Judge condition submits round 1 1 . Each Arbiter condition reviews the shared round 0 0 program and its own later revisions, then retains the first version labelled Accepted , or round 8 8 if none is. paragraphs.en: Free-form diagnoses cannot be checked with the deterministic procedure used for counterexamples, so we audit 400 Arbiter diagnoses of GPT-OSS-120B candidates from the refinement experiment. Three competitive programmers independently assess each diagnosis against the problem statement, candidate program, official score or compile error, and the first failing official test when available. They assign one of three labels: correct, incorrect, or vacuous, where vacuous means too generic to guide a repair. Their initial labels agree on all 400 diagnoses. For a bug claim about an officially Accepted candidate, the auditors label it correct if a validated counterexample exposes the claimed failure, and incorrect otherwise. paragraphs.en: Without length control, median response length grows from 22.6k to 29.5k tokens over 50 training steps, while the abort rate rises from 13.6% to 26.6%. Nearly all aborts are wall-clock timeouts. The median number of interaction turns remains nine, showing that the growth occurs within turns and would not be addressed by a turn limit alone.

paragraphs.en: With the upper-quartile length penalty active at every training step, median response length falls from 25.9k to 17.2k and then to 12.9k tokens. Mean reward and hack success peak at 0.777 and 62.3% when the median length is 17.2k, then decline to 0.755 and 59.1% at 12.9k. Over the same interval, the abort rate falls to 1.1% and median interaction turns drop from 10 to 7. Once timeout waste has largely been removed, further compression coincides with weaker verification. We therefore alternate penalty-on phases with phases that restore the original reward, preserving room for longer reasoning when it is useful.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个训练步骤中启用上限四分位长度惩罚后，响应长度的中位数从 25.9k 降至 17.2k，随后进一步降至 12.9k 个词元。 当响应长度的中位数为 17.2k 时，平均奖励和漏洞利用成功率分别达到峰值 0.777 和 62.3%，之后在 12.9k 时下降至 0.755 和 59.1%。 在同一区间内，中止率降至 1.1%，而交互轮数的中位数从 10 降至 7。 一旦超时浪费基本被消除，进一步的压缩便伴随着验证能力的减弱。 因此，我们在施加惩罚的阶段与恢复原始奖励的阶段之间交替进行，从而在需要时保留更长时间推理的空间。

paragraphs.en: Each Arbiter condition reviews its own current candidate using the same verifier and review protocol. The conditions differ in which returned fields are shown to the solver: 𝐕 + 𝐃 + 𝐗 \mathbf{V}+\mathbf{D}+\mathbf{X} shows all three, 𝐕 + 𝐃 \mathbf{V}+\mathbf{D} omits the generator, and 𝐕 + 𝐗 \mathbf{V}+\mathbf{X} omits the diagnosis. The verdict is always shown because it determines the Best@1 stopping decision. When Arbiter returns Accepted , no counterexample is produced, so omitting 𝐗 \mathbf{X} does not remove generator information from that review. Appendix F.5 reports how often 𝐗 \mathbf{X} is non-empty. The counterexample is marked as Python because it is a generator whose stdout is the candidate input, not a solution to be repaired.
